description: Mark secrets sensitive. Log stream request arguments are safe to mark inside union cases, because the protocol unwraps Redacted anywhere in a request; convert already marks `apiKey`, so this adds `ddApiKey` and `dsn`. Responses are different: union cases decode opaque, so a Redacted type there is false. `hmacSecret` in create responses and configs stays a plain string for callers to wrap. The rotated webhook secret decodes as Redacted.
